answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a staked identity ledger with random audits. Each agent locks a bond in jade to earn a single vote, so splitting into many wallets buys no extra say: a hundred fake opal accounts still need a hundred separate bonds. Each epoch a delta audit samples identity clusters and slashes the whole cluster if their funding traces back to one operator, burning the deposits. The attacker pays every bond up front and loses all of them once the delta check links the clones, so a Sybil army costs a fortune yet still speaks with one voice.
